name: qa_pr_view
description: Fetch PR metadata with CI-related fields stripped. Returns title, body, additions, deletions, files, labels, state, branch info, and author. Does NOT return CI check status, merge status, or commit-level check data.

pr_url.description: Full PR URL (e.g., https://github.com/senara-solutions/mika/pull/495) or owner/repo#number format

name: run_gh
description: Run a GitHub CLI command. Restricted to: pr review, pr diff, pr list, issue view. Use qa_pr_view for PR metadata instead of pr view.

command.description: Command arguments for gh CLI (e.g., ["pr", "review", "455", "--approve", "--body", "VERDICT: pass"])

repo.description: GitHub repository in owner/repo format (e.g., senara-solutions/mika)
